issues.title: Thin content
issues.howToFix: Either expand the page with genuinely useful content, noindex it, or consolidate it into a stronger page. If the content exists but is rendered by JavaScript, ensure it is server-rendered or pre-rendered.

decision: Retain functional 107-word tools hub with one actual tool and useful tutorial/format links; do not add filler or noindex solely to remove this heuristic warning. No issue reported for the new guide.
